note: GD.8 (FD.20; DF.4b / DF.21 residual 'a name reached only through an `export` re-export'). lib/app.dart is a library barrel, `export 'src/svc.dart' hide Hidden;`. Baseline HEAD a8323fe7: the Dart parser read no `export` directive, so `import 'package:app/app.dart';` bound none of the names app.dart re-exports: only `lib::main IMPORTS lib::app` (plus Runner::run -> Svc::go, bound by the repo-unique field-type fallback). After GD.8 the export is DT.1q's ReExportStar plus a ReExportHide, app.dart IMPORTS svc.dart (rule reexport) and Svc joins app.dart's module_symbols, so the plain import binds the construction, the static call and the field's construction. `hide Hidden` keeps svc.dart's Hidden out of app.dart, so old.dart's plain imports of app.dart and src/legacy.dart do not clash on Hidden: `Hidden()` binds legacy's (with hide ignored both imports would declare it and neither would bind), never svc's. `Svc().go()` -> Svc::go is a call on a construction's result, which Dart binds through no import (a direct `import 'src/svc.dart'` binds it neither), so it is not a row here.
